description: Key handling in the tabs of the main window that are not the mail tab: calendar, tasks, settings, the address book, about: pages, search results and chat. The chrome runtime matches keys locally, scrolls the page, and reports only the finished commands that run in the background.

functions.name: install
functions.description: Installs the compiled page keymap, or replaces the one installed. The first call starts the key listeners and later calls add none.

pageTree.description: The one loose object of the API. It is the compiled page keymap as data: a version the parent checks, and the root branch whose leaves name command ids. The parent walks it with the key matcher and runs a leaf only when its id is in the fixed table of reading actions. A deep schema would copy the compiler's tree shape and break on each change to it.

typingTree.description: The compiled typing keymap as data, loose for the reason of the other trees. Its keys run while a text field has the focus.

holdCommands.description: Ids of the commands that open the overlay. After one fires, plain keys are dropped until the focus reaches a text field, the tab changes or 1.5 seconds pass.

messageTree.description: The compiled message keymap as data, loose for the reason of `pageTree`. It is the tree of a message tab with the focus outside the body.

events.name: onInvocation
events.description: A key sequence finished on a command that runs in the background, in a tab that is not the mail tab, or the key list ended. The payload is output only, so it takes no argument check.

command.description: A command id, or "pending" for a change of the half-typed sequence. That event carries `keys`, `windowId`, and `source` and `root` when a page tab sends them.

keys.description: The typed key tokens of a pending sequence, counts left out. Empty when the sequence ended.

source.description: Which tree the panel of a pending event lists. Left out, it is the mail tree.

root.description: With no keys: show the root of the tree at once, and do not end the panel.

messageIds.description: The MailExtension ids of the messages selected at the key press.
